castOption.label: Blood Detonation (2 Crimson Charges)
castOption.note: Needs your Ketsuryugan active. Creatures failing by 2 or more treat it as a Critical Failure.

system.description:
As part of the requirements for casting this jutsu, you must have the Ketsuryūgan active. You make eye contact with a creature as you mentally hijack the blood flow to their brain. The creature must make a Wisdom saving throw. Affected creatures can repeat their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, and once per turn when they would take damage. A creature resistant or immune to being Demoralized has advantage on this saving throw.

Blood Detonation. Creatures that fail this jutsu’s save by 2 or more, treat it as if they Critically failed..

Success: The creature experiences a mild tension headache, but is able to resist this jutsu's effects, ending this jutsu.

Failure: The target begins to hallucinate, distorting the appearance of creatures around them. Affected creature sees current hostile creatures as allies and their current allies as hostile for the duration. The creature is also unable to omit creatures from being affected by an attack or jutsu for the duration.

Critical Failure: Same effects as a failure, however, the creature is now swarmed with panic. A creature under this jutsu's effects can only move, take the attack action, or cast a jutsu of C-Rank or lower on their turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of creatures you can target by +1.
